finding: `tasks scope add` overwrites the embedded taskDirectionLock.allowedFiles with ONLY the newly-added paths (plus the task ledger paths) instead of unioning them with the existing scope. After an in-flight scope amendment on TASK-SKL-0029, the direction lock allowedFiles collapsed to just the two added files (contract-import-recovery.ts, import-orchestrator.ts) and dropped all eight original deliverables. Every subsequent governed `atm git commit` then fails its pre-commit hook with ATM_HOOK_PRE_COMMIT_DEFERRED_GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED / ATM_TASK_DIRECTION_SCOPE_DRIFT on the original scope files (run.ts, close-preflight.ts, review-advisory.ts, auto-evidence-mapper.ts, write-readiness.ts, both templates, the focused test).
expectedBehavior: `tasks scope add` must UNION the added paths into the existing taskDirectionLock.allowedFiles (and the claim scope) so previously-authorized deliverables remain committable. Adding scope must never revoke already-granted scope.
